hero_kpi_rationale: Reflects a stable shareholder return policy in the banking sector, with regular increases in quarterly dividends approved by the board of directors, demonstrating a commitment to shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Amount paid per share to shareholders each quarter.
kpis.description: The board of directors approved a quarterly dividend of $0.37 per share in Q1 2026, an increase of $0.03 from $0.34 in the prior year.
kpis.signal: Dividend increase of 2.8% compared to Q1 2025.

kpis.name: Share Repurchase Program
kpis.explanation: Amount authorized for repurchase of company shares.
kpis.description: The board of directors authorized on May 13, 2025 a share repurchase program with a maximum value of $50 million, effective through July 31, 2026. Repurchases may be made in the open market or through private negotiation at the company's discretion.
kpis.signal: $50 million share repurchase program authorized through July 31, 2026.

kpis.name: Interest Rate Sensitivity (100 bp increase over 12 months)
kpis.explanation: Impact of an immediate 100 basis point increase on forecasted net interest income over 12 months.
kpis.description: According to ALCO analyses as of December 31, 2025, an immediate and parallel 100 bp increase in interest rates would result in a 0.6% increase in forecasted net interest income over the next 12 months, reflecting an asset-sensitive balance sheet position.
kpis.signal: Balance sheet sensitive to rising rates: 0.6% increase in net interest income over 12 months for a 100 bp increase.

risks.title: Credit risks and potential losses
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the Forward-Looking Statements and detailed in the Allowance for Credit Losses section. Language intensity is high with reference to adequate credit provisions and adverse economic scenarios. The Credit category weighting is very high for a banking institution.

risks.title: Interest rate risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in the Forward-Looking Statements with clear language on sensitivity to interest rate environment and yield curve changes. Context indicates direct impact on revenues and costs. The Macro category is relevant for a financial institution.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risks
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in the Forward-Looking Statements under cybersecurity concerns. Language is direct and the category is clearly identified. This risk is critical for financial institutions.

risks.title: Technology and innovation risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the Forward-Looking Statements as risk related to rapid technological developments, including AI and digital assets. Context emphasizes the need to maintain competitiveness in product and service innovation.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: Present in the Forward-Looking Statements under regulatory supervision, notably modifications to regulatory capital requirements. Language is precise with reference to changes in regulatory and government policies.

risks.title: Operational and failure risks
risks.score_rationale: Included in the Forward-Looking Statements under operational risks and risk management failures by the company or critical third parties, including fraud risk. Language covers a broad spectrum of potential failures.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risks
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the Forward-Looking Statements under management of internal growth and acquisitions, with clear language on potential integration difficulties and failure to realize expected benefits. The Capital category is appropriate.

ai_positioning.summary: STBA mentions AI in a very limited manner in its 10-K filing, only as a potential technology risk among other rapid technological developments, without differentiated strategic positioning around AI.
evidence: Forward-Looking Statements mention 'rapid technological developments and changes, including the use of artificial intelligence and digital assets' as a potential risk
